description: Use when an agent needs a major coin's USD price by ticker. Input: symbols, 1-5 of BTC, ETH, SOL, USDC, AERO, DEGEN, BONK, JUP, CBBTC, WETH. Output: per symbol priceUsd, confidence, DEX pool (Uniswap/Aerodrome on Base, Orca on Solana), depth, block or slot, and the token used (BTC = cbBTC, ETH = WETH). Onchain pools only, no exchange feed. Example: ?symbols=BTC,ETH Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

symbols.description: 1-5 tickers, comma-separated (BTC, ETH, SOL, USDC, AERO, DEGEN, BONK, JUP, CBBTC, WETH; alias symbol). Unknown ticker → 400 before payment

name: crypto_price
title: Crypto price by ticker (BTC, ETH, SOL…) from onchain DEX pools, with pool, depth and confidence
